hero.title: Free AI API Directory
hero.subtitle: A collection of free tier, open-source, and free credits LLM APIs for developers.

directory.how_it_works_desc: Our system operates entirely automatically (100% backend-less). Every night at 00:00 UTC, a GitHub Actions robot fetches raw data from various available community API sources. The data is then cleaned, standardized, and merged into a single file. Because this site is statically compiled, you can search and filter this list with nearly zero loading time!
